pages: A bell is a sound. A sound cannot hurt the dead. I have written that sentence nine times and it is still true and it still did not work. The ground held. Something was done to the ground - not magic, there is no magic, something in the order in which things were done: washed, wrapped, named, lowered, covered, told. I have been approaching this from the wrong end. I have been teaching the dead to get up. They have been teaching the dead to stay.
